WITH account_region_totals AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_total, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(account_total) AS region_total
  FROM account_region_totals
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT art.account_id, art.region, art.account_total, art.transaction_count,
       CAST(art.account_total AS REAL) / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_region_totals AS art
JOIN region_totals AS rt ON art.region = rt.region
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
